data.narrative:
QuEra Computing is a Series B quantum computing company that has raised $230M to date. The quantum computing sector comprises 11 comparable companies: 3 public firms (IonQ, Rigetti Computing, D-Wave Quantum) and 8 private competitors including Quantinuum and Infleqtion.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable valuation method. Using $230M in total raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical for Series B advancement yields an implied valuation of $437M. This reflects the step-up in company value expected between Series B and subsequent funding rounds in this sector. A peer-median approach could not be applied: while 6 same-sector comparables exist, none met the threshold of three or more datapoints within the same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier necessary for reliable triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $371M to $503M, centered on a median of $437M. This single-method result carries elevated uncertainty. The primary limitation is the absence of sufficient same-stage or valuation-tier quantum computing peers to cross-check the stage-progression output. Any material refinement would require either additional private market transactions in quantum computing at the Series B level or clearer revenue and growth metrics for existing comparables.
